summary: Similarweb Ltd. furnished a Form -6K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) containing a supplement to its October 8, 2026 proxy statement ahead of a November 16, 2026 Special General Meeting. The supplement adds detail on the 19-company compensation peer group and 11 non-founder CEO benchmark peers used by advisor Aon to benchmark new CEO Michael Akkerman's pay, placing terms near the 25th-50th percentile. No proposal terms, meeting date, or record date change; previously submitted proxies remain valid. This is routine proxy disclosure, not a special situation; watch only for shareholder vote outcome.
